sloka: ततो रामो महातेजा विस्मयात्पुनरेव हि ।उवाच प्रणतो वाक्यमगस्त्यमृषिसत्तमम् ।। ७.३१.१ ॥
transliteration: tato rāmo mahātejā vismayātpunareva hi ।uvāca praṇato vākyamagastyamṛṣisattamam ।। 7.31.1 ॥

translations.english: Then, the greatly effulgent Rama, filled with wonder, again spoke words to Agastya, the best among sages, bowing down to him.
